section.heading: Professional Experience
section.description: A compact overview of the teams I've helped build, the products I've shipped, and the measurable outcomes I've delivered.

description: Forward-deployed lead for a team of 4 across Pitch Intel, Chat AI, RAPID and MCP Playground — owning discovery, architecture and delivery, embedded with business and engineering.
Pitch Intel, an agentic sales-intelligence platform, cut pitch-report preparation from ~3 days to ~30 minutes.
Chat AI MCP server adopted by 100+ customers; RAPID turned 300+ APIs into one MCP toolset and lifted LLM API-selection accuracy from ~85% to 95%+.
roleAndResponsibilities: Lead a forward-deployed team of 4 engineers, embedded with business and engineering, across the agent, API and UI layers.
Run technical discovery and solution scoping with sales, commercial-pricing and product teams, then own the build through production.
Own platform delivery for 15+ microservices, including Helm packaging, Kubernetes upgrades, security hardening and production releases.
projectHighlights: Pitch Intel — agentic sales-intelligence platform with a drag-and-drop workflow builder, a shared agent gallery with RBAC, and research-backed reports delivered as infographics, HTML, PDF and PowerPoint.

Chat AI MCP Server — customer-facing MCP server exposing the SPGCI Python SDK, adopted by 100+ customers across MS Copilot, Claude and Databricks; LLM-generated code execution for structured data and AIRD APIs for unstructured data kept answer parity without SME review cycles.

RAPID MCP Server — 300+ APIs behind four tools (instructions, search, metadata, execute) with no microservice changes, saving hundreds of engineering hours; search-and-rerank discovery took API selection accuracy from ~85% to 95%+.

MCP Playground — initiated and now used by 10+ teams to test servers against multiple models with real queries, plus a consistency framework that compares tool calls and arguments across repeated runs and scores release confidence.

API Platform — moved 15+ microservices from raw Kubernetes manifests to Helm charts (~25% less deploy-day friction), fixed critical vulnerabilities, purged hardcoded secrets from git history across 10 repositories, and instrumented OpenSearch dashboards over cluster events and metrics.

description: Built a Text2SQL chat app so the product team could query orders, complaints and products in natural language, cutting ad-hoc data-team requests by ~25%.
Extended it with a watchdog agent that proactively surfaces emerging issues — paper shortages, material alternatives, waste and delays.
Replaced legacy Forge systems with RabbitMQ + Celery microservices, lifting throughput ~50%.
roleAndResponsibilities: Delivered GenAI and modernization work for a US client from discovery through production support.
Owned on-call rotations and kept client systems running through peak seasonal load.
Worked directly with client product and engineering stakeholders to translate business needs into shipped features.
projectHighlights: Product Intelligence Agent — Text2SQL chat application over orders, complaints and products, with a LangGraph feedback loop that self-corrects SQL errors; cut ad-hoc data-team requests by ~25%.
Watchdog Agent — layered on the same product logic to proactively flag emerging issues such as paper shortages, material alternatives, waste and delivery delays.
Forge Module — production microservices (PDF generation, cutlines, template mapping) on RabbitMQ with Celery workers, lifting throughput ~50%.
Mnesia DB Viewer — full-stack tool (Python subprocess) with Erlang OTP cluster tooling for data correction and restoration, saving ~$10K per production incident.

description: Drove the migration of Ledger Insights from legacy .NET to Python, React, AWS and PostgreSQL, improving experience and lifting customer retention ~35%.
Scaled premium features (AR Requests, CFO Reports, trade groups, Combined Experience) that supported B2B deals worth ~$150K.
Built a data-editing tool used across entities, raising company data quality from ~85% to ~95%.
roleAndResponsibilities: Worked across backend services and React pages as the platform moved from .NET to a modern Python and AWS stack.
Improved code quality and performance through reviews, pair programming and knowledge sharing.
Maintained technical documentation and architecture notes to keep the team aligned.
projectHighlights: Ledger Insights — end-to-end contribution to migrating the platform from legacy .NET to Python, React, AWS and PostgreSQL, improving UX and lifting customer retention ~35%.
Premium features — AR Requests, CFO Reports, trade groups and Combined Experience across backend services and React pages, supporting B2B deals worth ~$150K.
Global Data Editing Tool — Flask application used across entities to correct inaccurate and redundant company data, raising data quality from ~85% to ~95%.
US customer data APIs — REST endpoints over business expenditure, trade payments and accounts receivable, with authorization workflows that push audited records back to production databases.
